# Phase 1 Synthetic Fixtures

These fixtures are deliberately fake and safe to track. They are not real ALA,
camera-trap, spatial, predictor, or species data.

The fixture names, coordinates, species, and identifiers are synthetic. Camera
rows use `pa_type=survey_supported_absence` with `survey_supported_absence_rule_id=P1-D009`;
exact site, deployment, and current-activity fields are intentionally absent.
They exist only to test the Phase 1 contract scaffold before any live or legacy
payload is read.
